id: \bBrock uses Rock type Pokémon. They are weak against Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, and Steel types.
en: \bBrock uses Rock type Pokémon. They are weak against Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, and Steel types.
it: \bBrock usa Pokémon di tipo Roccia. Sono deboli contro i tipi Acqua, Erba, Lotta, Terra e Acciaio.

id: \bDespite all the weaknesses, they are strong against Fire, Bug, Flying, and Ice. Normal and Poison moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bDespite all the weaknesses, they are strong against Fire, Bug, Flying, and Ice. Normal and Poison moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bNonostante tutte queste debolezze, sono forti contro Fuoco, Coleottero, Volante e Ghiaccio. Anche le mosse di tipo Normale e Veleno non fanno molti danni.

id: \bYou're pretty hot. But not as hot as Brock!
en: \bYou're pretty hot. But not as hot as Brock!
it: \bSei proprio in gamba. Ma non quanto Brock!

id: \bBrock: So, you're here. I'm Brock. I'm Pewter City's Gym Leader.
en: \bBrock: So, you're here. I'm Brock. I'm Pewter City's Gym Leader.
it: \bBrock: Allora sei qui. Sono Brock, il Capopalestra di Plumbeopoli.

id: \bMy rock-hard willpower is shown even in my Pokémon. My Pokémon are all rock hard, and have true-grit determination.
en: \bMy rock-hard willpower is shown even in my Pokémon. My Pokémon are all rock hard, and have true-grit determination.
it: \bLa mia volontà di roccia si riflette anche nei miei Pokémon. Sono tutti duri come la roccia e hanno una determinazione d'acciaio.
\bBrock: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Sasso.

id: \bA TM, Technical Machine, contains a technique for Pokémon.
en: \bA TM, Technical Machine, contains a technique for Pokémon.
it: \bUna MT, Macchina Tecnica, contiene una tecnica per i Pokémon.

id: \bTM80 contains Rock Slide. It inflicts damage and has a chance to make the opponent flinch.
en: \bTM80 contains Rock Slide. It inflicts damage and has a chance to make the opponent flinch.
it: \bLa MT80 contiene Frana. Infligge danni e può far tentennare l'avversario.

id: \bBrock: I actually wanted to be a Pokémon Breeder, not a Gym Leader, but I do it for my family.
en: \bBrock: I actually wanted to be a Pokémon Breeder, not a Gym Leader, but I do it for my family.
it: \bBrock: In realtà volevo diventare un Allevatore di Pokémon, non un Capopalestra, ma lo faccio per la mia famiglia.

id: \bCame to see me did you? I'm still training to be a doctor. How are your goals coming?
en: \bCame to see me did you? I'm still training to be a doctor. How are your goals coming?
it: \bSei venuto a trovarmi, eh? Mi sto ancora preparando per diventare medico. E i tuoi obiettivi come procedono?

id: \bNevermind. It might be easier to just show me.
en: \bNevermind. It might be easier to just show me.
it: \bLascia stare. Forse è più facile se me lo mostri.

id: \bBrock: Good to see you \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
en: \bBrock: Good to see you \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
it: \bBrock: Che bello vederti, \PN! Se vuoi, posso fare la toelettatura a uno dei tuoi Pokémon. Potrebbe aiutarlo in lotta.

id: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
en: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
it: \bBrock: A quale Pokémon vuoi che faccia la toelettatura?

id: \bBrock: There! \v[2] looks a lot better now!
en: \bBrock: There!  \v[2] looks a lot better now!
it: \bBrock: Ecco fatto!  \v[2] ha un aspetto molto migliore ora!
